components.name: kb_hold_close_up
components.meaning: 本日收盘价严格大于同前复权前一日收盘价；有限的前复权非正收盘仍可比较
components.unknown: 前一日或当日有效收盘缺失

components.name: kb_hold_above_bbi
components.meaning: 收盘在同口径KB BBI之上；有限的前复权非正收盘可参与平均
components.unknown: 不足24根、数据无效或收盘恰等于BBI时正文表述不一致

components.name: kb_hold_volume_ok
components.meaning: 阳线得分：同口径有效收盘价严格高于有效开盘价得1；收盘价小于或等于开盘价得0。该比较不依赖最高价、最低价或成交量；有限的前复权非正开收仍可比较
components.unknown: 开盘价或收盘价缺失、非有限或无效

components.name: kb_hold_trend_up
components.meaning: 用户确认的 N V1：以完整同股前缀确认相邻高低点并判断趋势
components.unknown: 确认点不足、同根高低点次序不明或输入无效；按 N V1 来源状态保留

components.name: kb_hold_j_not_dead
components.meaning: J未同时低于K和D；判定当前状态而非仅下穿瞬间
components.unknown: 不足9根或KDJ递推输入无效

total: 各确定true得1；任一分项未知时总分为null，最小值为已确认得分，最大值加未知分项数
reason_fields: 每项对应 _reason 字段：RULE_NOT_QUANTIFIED 表示规则待量化；INVALID_OPEN_CLOSE_INPUT 表示阳线得分所需开盘或收盘无效；INSUFFICIENT_* 或其他 INVALID_* 表示行情或预热不足；BBI_EQUALITY_UNRESOLVED 表示源文相等边界歧义；已确定分项为 null

user_rule_decision.decision: 收盘>开盘得1；收盘<=开盘得0；仅开收缺失或无效才UNKNOWN。该分项不依赖量、高、低。

indicator_basis: KB core.py BBI=(MA3+MA6+MA12+MA24)/4 round2; KDJ RSV9 with K=D=50 initialization and round2; no source defaults used for insufficient history

n_structure.structure_diagnostics: same-symbol/date sidecar and view; no extra wide panel column

indicator_reuse.J: existing kb_b1_j; project_single_history validates equality for each row before output
indicator_reuse.BBI: independent KB core round2 value: 2/2288 comparable historical rows differ from round2(existing BBI)
indicator_reuse.K_D: independent KB core initialization and round2: K 24/2303 and D 30/2303 comparable rows differ from round2(existing kdj_k/d)
